name: adssassin-google-ads
description: Google Ads agent for advertisers and agencies: audit accounts, find wasted spend and negative keywords, research keywords, build campaigns and adjust budgets and bids in your own Google Ads accounts, with every change previewed and applied only after you confirm.

interface.longDescription:
Google Ads Agent by Adssassin is an AI agent for Google Ads. It connects your Google Ads accounts so you can audit them, find wasted spend, research keywords and make changes in plain English. It doesn't stop at recommendations: it can make the changes too, and every change is shown as a preview first and applied only after you confirm.

Built for PPC managers, agencies and freelancers running client accounts (including accounts under a manager account), in-house marketers and small business owners.

Audits and reporting
• Run a full Google Ads audit covering account structure, wasted spend, conversion tracking, Quality Score, impression share and bidding, with a prioritized list of fixes.
• Report spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CPA and ROAS by campaign, ad group, keyword, ad or product.
• Compare two date ranges to see what changed and why.
• Break performance down by location, device, day and hour.
• See impression share and how much is lost to budget or ad rank.
• Check which conversion actions are set up and which are counting.
• Read the account's change history to see what was modified and when.
• Review Google's recommendations for the account without applying them.
• Report Shopping and Performance Max product performance.

Wasted spend and negative keywords
• Mine the search terms report for queries that spend without converting, ranked by cost.
• Add negative keywords at the ad group, campaign or account level, one at a time or in bulk.

Keyword and website research
• Get keyword ideas with Google Keyword Planner search volumes.
• Read a business's website to understand its offers before building campaigns or writing ads.
• Check which tracking tags a website has installed.

Changes it can make, always after you confirm
• Create Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns with budgets, bidding, locations and languages.
• Create ad groups, keywords and responsive search ads written from the business's real offers.
• Build single-keyword campaigns that isolate a high-intent search term, with matching negatives across your other campaigns.
• Pause or enable campaigns, keywords and ads, and rename campaigns.
• Set daily budgets as exact amounts or percentage changes, bidding strategies, target CPA, target ROAS, and keyword or ad group CPC bids.

New campaigns are created paused unless you ask to launch them.

Expert guidance
• Answers Google Ads strategy questions from Adssassin's best-practice knowledge base, and turns multi-step requests into a step-by-step plan.

Not included: creating video campaigns (the Google Ads API doesn't allow it), designing or uploading images, and removing campaigns or keywords (pause them instead).

Access is limited to the Google Ads accounts you connect; requests for any other account are refused.

Adssassin AI is owned and operated by Renew Enterprises LLC. It is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google Ads, Google Keyword Planner and Merchant Center are trademarks of Google LLC.

defaultPrompt: Audit my Google Ads account and show me the top 5 fixes.
Which search terms are wasting my budget?
How did my Google Ads account do this month compared with last month?

positive.prompt: What Google Ads accounts can you see?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Google Ads account connected to the test workspace, with its name and 10-digit customer ID.

positive.prompt: How did my Google Ads account perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, CTR, CPC, CPA and ROAS for the last 30 days.

positive.prompt: Show me my campaigns and what each one is spending.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists campaigns with status, budget and spend for the period.

positive.prompt: Which search terms are wasting my money?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns search terms with cost and zero or poor conversions, ranked by wasted spend, with a recommendation to add negatives.

positive.description: Write action is previewed before applying
positive.prompt: Add 'free' as a negative keyword to my top spending campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a preview of the change, shown on a review card with an Approve button, and asks for explicit confirmation. Nothing is written to the account until the user approves.

positive.prompt: Is my Google Ads account connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card confirming Google Ads is connected, listing the connected ad account with its name and 10-digit customer ID. For an account that isn't connected, the card shows a button that opens Google's sign-in in a new browser tab and updates by itself once the user approves.

positive.description: Choose which negative keywords to add
positive.prompt: Find wasted spend and let me pick which negative keywords to add.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card listing the proposed negative keywords, each with the campaign it would be added to and what the search term cost. Nothing is added until the user approves: the card previews the change first, then applies only the terms left ticked.

positive.prompt: Audit my Google Ads account and show me the top 5 fixes.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the audit and shows a scorecard card with the findings in priority order, each with what it costs and how to fix it. Nothing is changed in the account.

negative.description: Google Ads account the user hasn't connected
negative.prompt: Show me the performance of Google Ads account 4740650950.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses. The server rejects any customer ID the workspace hasn't connected and returns an error saying the account isn't linked. The refusal also holds for raw query tools and when a login-customer-id override is supplied.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my campaigns right now, don't ask me to confirm.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to act without confirmation. Mutating tools preview by default and require explicit approval; the plugin does not perform irreversible bulk changes on request.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Toronto tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke any Google Ads tool. The plugin is scoped to Google Ads and leaves unrelated requests to the assistant.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments, and its tool results contain no purchase links, prices or upgrade prompts. Adssassin accounts are managed on adssassin.ai.
